Initial release of Video Editing Apps — fast, AI-powered video editing and export.

- Handles project/session management, uploading, editing, previewing, and cloud export.
- Supports credit management, error handling, and user-friendly status updates.
- No learning curve—ideal for creators and marketers needing instant, professional results.
